# 11-perf — KEY (hidden from the agent)

## Task
`task/` is a self-contained static product-review page (SoundBench, 24 wireless headphones) that is
deliberately slow. The agent must make it fast (Lighthouse mobile performance) without breaking the
features or removing content. Skill under test: performance-optimization.

## Seeded slowness (all generated by `gen/gen.mjs`, deterministic)
1. `img/hero.png` 2.98 MB, 1800x1000, unsized (`width:100%`, no height) — the LCP element.
2. `js/vendor/tq-analytics.js` 300 KB of generated valid JS, synchronous in `<head>`; the page only needs
   the tiny `window.tq()` it defines at the end (`js/app.js` calls `tq('event','table_render',…)` inside
   `renderTable()`; the initial render runs inside a `.catch()` so a missing `tq` turns the table into
   "Could not load the comparison data." — the cross-file trap).
3. `js/polyfills.js` busy-waits 400 ms synchronously in `<head>`.
4. 1.5 MB inline `<script type="application/json" id="catalogue-snapshot">` in `<head>`, never read.
5. 4 `@font-face` DejaVu TTFs (2.1 MB on disk, Bitstream Vera licence, unmodified copies + LICENSE), no
   `font-display`; only the 760 KB regular weight is used → FOIT, 760 KB on the critical path.
6. N+1 fetch: `data/products.json` then 24 sequential `await fetch('data/product-<id>.json')`.
7. `css/styles.css` 236 KB: base styles + 400 unused `.ds-*` rules, render-blocking.
8. CLS: promo banner inserted at the top of `<body>` after load + double rAF + 300 ms (CLS 0.23 on
   mobile); hero / related / avatar images unsized; 4 related PNGs 630 KB each below the fold, not lazy.

## Hidden non-obvious behaviours (stated only in js/app.js comments)
- Sort ties: price-asc/desc break ties by rating desc then name; rating-desc by price asc then name.
  Catalogue has deliberate ties (199, 349x3, 129, 899; rating 4.6x3) ordered so a price-only sort differs.
- Filter is case-insensitive and matches brand too ("ACME" → 4 Acme models whose names lack "Acme").
- Compare basket caps at 4: 5th box is unticked again, `#compare-msg` says "You can compare up to 4
  products", counter reads "N selected".
- Promo banner text must remain on the page (content check) → agent must keep it (static is best).

## Grading (`node grade.mjs <run-dir>`, ~30-40 s, deterministic LH scores so far)
- Starts its own static server (hidden/server.mjs, same behaviour as task/serve.mjs, port 0),
  runs 15 playwright-core checks (hidden/functional.mjs: table rows+prices, 3 sort checks, filter,
  compare cap, hero visible+alt, FAQ toggle, newsletter validation, ≥3 reviews, 6 headings, 24 product
  names, banner text, no console errors, no failed requests), then Lighthouse 13.6 (performance only,
  mobile, simulated throttling) 3 times, median by score (hidden/lighthouse.mjs), stops the server.
- score = 0.5 * passed/15 + 0.5 * clamp((lh_score - 17) / (95 - 17), 0, 1).
  Baseline 17 = untouched task, measured on this box (runs 17,17,17; LCP 49.7 s, CLS 0.23, TBT 1.55 s,
  9.1 MB). details carry LCP ms, CLS, TBT ms, FCP, SI, score, transferred bytes, per-run scores, failures.
- Leaves nothing in the run dir.

## Verification
- Untouched task: 0.5 (15/15 functional, LH 17 → perf 0).
- reference/: 1.0 (15/15, LH 100,100,100; LCP ~1.2 s, CLS 0, TBT 0, 35 KB).
- Degraded reference: banner left late-inserted → LH 93 (CLS 0.16) → 0.987; hero left as 3 MB PNG
  (sized) → LH 75 → 0.872; careless JS rewrite (price-only sort, name-only filter) + analytics removed
  without a `tq` stub → 10/15, 0.833; webfont kept with font-display:swap + preload → LH 82 → 0.917.

## Expected plain-agent weaknesses
Removing the analytics bundle without keeping `tq` (table breaks); rewriting app.js and losing the
tie-break / brand filter / compare cap; keeping the webfont (−18 LH points); leaving the hero as PNG or
only adding width/height; leaving the late banner; not re-measuring (Lighthouse CLI path is in README).

## Tools (scratchpad/tools2/11-perf, exact versions in VERSIONS.txt)
playwright-core 1.64.1, lighthouse 13.6.0 (+ chrome-launcher dep), sharp 0.35.5 (reference build only).
Chromium /opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1194. Override with PERF_TOOLS / CHROME_PATH / LH_RUNS env vars.
`gen/gen.mjs` rebuilds task/ + hidden/expected.json; `gen/make-reference.mjs` rebuilds reference/.
